evidence: Carries the Wallet label and updates PSBT generation in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and descriptor processing.
rationale: Populating PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB resolves hardware signer failures where devices like BitBox02 via HWI refuse to sign multisig setups without global xpubs. Fixing this omission provides meaningful reliability and interoperability value for multisig hardware wallet users.
